name: Love at the Laundromat
source:
Like any young girl fresh from graduation, Lynn dreams of making a name for herself. Of what she makes a name for was something she hasn't seriously considered. Did it really matter? Leave the fates to worry about such things. Packing up what meager belongings she owned, she ventures off to see what the world has to offer.

Three months later, Lynn isn't too sure she likes the path the fates are planning for her. In debt and jobless isn't really her first choice in the list of things she wanted to be. Maybe setting off on her own with no special training, education, experience, or plan was not one of her best ideas. With the threat of eviction looming over her, Lynn must find a way to quickly make ends meet or face facts and go home. If only her sour luck would work in her favor for once. If past experience was anything to go by, Lynn isn't too keen on the idea of how things might turn out.
translation: 像任何剛畢業的年輕女孩一樣，琳夢想著闖出一片天地。至於在哪方面闖出名堂，她沒有認真想過。真的重要嗎？讓命運去操心這些事吧。收拾好僅有的行李，她踏上了看看世界能給她什麼的旅程。三個月後，琳不太確定自己是否喜歡命運為她安排的道路。負債累累、失業在家並不是她理想清單上的首選。也許在沒有專業技能、學歷、經驗或計畫的情況下獨自出發並不是她最好的主意。在被驅逐的威脅籠罩下，琳必須想辦法儘快維持生計，否則就只能面對現實回家了。要是她的壞運氣也能轉好一次就好了。如果過去的經驗可以作為參考，琳對事情的走向並不太樂觀。
